senses.gloss: m. (v. אֵגוֹר, אֲגוֹרָה) fit for storage, of good quality.
units: Kel. XVII, 8 the olive (as a size standard) … neither large nor small, but of medium size, זה א׳ which is the kind called egori.
<cite ref="Berakhot 39a:3">Ber. 39ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bikkurim 1:3:3">Y. Bicc. I, 63ᵈ</cite> (etymol. explan.); v. <cite ref="A00215"><he>אִבְרוֹסִי</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 851:1">Yalk. Deut. 851</cite> <he>זית א׳</he>.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 91:11">Gen. R. s. 91</cite>, end <he>מור אי׳</he> myrrh fit for storage.—Pl. <cite ref="A00282"><he>אֵגוֹרִין</he></cite> <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 4">Num. R. s. 4</cite> beg. <he>חטים אגודיהן</he>, read <he>אֵגוֹרִין הם</he> are all storage wheat (opp. <cite ref="I00396"><he>טינופת</he></cite>). Cmp. <cite ref="A00344"><he>אגרו</he></cite>.
